title: PROFILING-ROUTE-ANNOTATION-001: resolve postponed annotations in @safety_critical
intent: Fix the decorator-annotation binding defect identified as PROFILING-ROUTE-ANNOTATION-001 during RMOS-CONVERGE-001B-B2 (PR #322). @safety_critical claimed to preserve the function signature for FastAPI but copied PEP 563 string annotations onto a wrapper defined in app/core/safety.py. FastAPI then resolved those strings against the wrapper's globals, failed, and treated Pydantic body models as required query parameters (422 loc=['query','req']). The handler never ran. The decorator now evaluates annotations against the wrapped function's module (inspect.signature(eval_str=True) + get_type_hints) so FastAPI sees real classes. This is the decorator contract made true under postponed annotations, not an RMOS evaluator and not a Body() sweep of individual routers.
behavior_change: FastAPI parameter binding is restored for @safety_critical routes that combine from __future__ import annotations with a bare Pydantic body parameter. Those routes no longer 422 on a missing query field named after the parameter. JSON bodies bind as declared. Builtin-scalar routes (retract /gcode) are unchanged. Fail-closed exception re-raise is unchanged. No RMOS feasibility gate is added; sibling G-code emitters that were accidentally unreachable become reachable as they were written. 001B-B2's HOLD on converging profiling, drilling, and V-carve is unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) services/api/app/core/safety.py: safety_critical now attaches inspect.signature(func, eval_str=True) and get_type_hints(func, include_extras=True) to the wrapper instead of the unevaluated PEP 563 signature. FastAPI therefore sees Pydantic classes, not strings resolved against app.core.safety globals. (2) profile_router.py and binding_router.py: map HTTP field names onto the generator dataclasses (stepdown_mm, feed_rate_xy, outline=) so restoring binding does not 500 on TypeError. (3) tests/test_safety_critical_annotation_binding.py: isolated FastAPI mini-app reproduces the 422 loc=['query','req'] pattern and proves JSON body binding; production endpoints keep evaluated model types; profiling and binding /gcode accept a JSON body and emit G-code. (4) docs/audit/PROFILING-ROUTE-ANNOTATION-001.md records the mechanism, bounded census, adapter follow-through, and non-goals. (5) Census §8 gains a pointer.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The decorator already documented 'preserve function signature for FastAPI' and already set wrapper.__signature__, which is why the 422 looked like a profiling bug. Copying the signature without evaluating postponed annotations is exactly the defect. Adding Body() to profile_router.py would have unblocked one route and left binding, V-carve production, inlay, radius dish, and feeds-speeds broken. Fixing the decorator closes the class. PR #322 correctly HOLDed RMOS gating of these siblings; this change does not gate them.
